name: MUXIS v1.2.11 — Prismatic Aura
body:
### What's New in MUXIS v1.2.11
- 1-Click Google Sign-In / Sign-Up enabled out-of-the-box via dedicated Firebase Auth client (`muxis-cloud` -> `https://muxis-cloud.web.app`), verifying Google identity tokens and storing all account profiles, devices, favorites, playlists, listening history, theme presets, and EQ DSP presets inside Cloudflare D1 (`muxis-cloud-db`)
- Full bidirectional Cloudflare D1 pull + push sync including Recently Played listening history, theme/accent presets, Audio Studio EQ preset, and synced track metadata across Windows, macOS, Linux, Android, and iPhone
